ma.tradePay(Object object)

Initiate payment (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
tradeNO String Yes Order ID, obtained by calling the order interface.
orderStr String Yes order details. A string spliced into order information
sign String Yes Order details signature
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String tradePay: ok
resultCode String return code
tradeNO String Order ID

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String tradePay: fail, + wrong reason
resultCode String return code

Usage Restrictions

  1. To use this interface, you need to connect to the Mini Program saas platform
  2. Using this interface requires the host application to implement and inject the payment method to obtain the host application (please refer to the Mini Program SDK Integration Document--Integrating Third-Party Payment Guidance Chapter)

Sample Code

ma.tradePay({
  tradeNO: 'tradeNO',
  orderStr: 'orderStr',
  sign: 'sign',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.resultCode);
    console.log(res.tradeNO);
  }
});
